# @basaltkit/cache

> 标签: basalt, cache, redis, typescript

## 简介

Driver-agnostic Basalt cache: tags, stale-while-revalidate, tenant scoping and an in-memory driver. Shared backends ship as their own packages (@basaltkit/cache-redis, -tiered).
